      "rationale": "Continuous testing of Guix release binaries and codesign manifests directly addresses release integrity before manual release engineering.       "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Extends test execution to newly built Guix binaries across native runners for multiple platforms. While primarily CI orchestration, the test runner adds coverage against build-time regressions in release configurations."
